name: gizza-ai/image-fetch
summary: Fetch an image URL and return it for inline display.

tool.description: Fetch an image and render it inline. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call).

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
